Single-row horizontal pipeline diagram for a TOP-VENUE academic paper (EMNLP/NeurIPS level). Full column width, aspect ratio ~3.5:1, figsize (14, 4) inches.

PIPELINE: 5 stages flowing left-to-right, connected by elegant thin arrows.

Stage 1 — "Source Data" (leftmost, ~18% width):
  - Rounded rectangle box, background warm gray (#F0EDEB), border (#D5D0CC) 1pt
  - Title: "Source Data" in bold serif 11pt, dark charcoal (#2C3E50)
  - Subtitle line 1: "LLMBar Natural +" in regular serif 8.5pt, muted gray (#5D6D7E)
  - Subtitle line 2: "Adversarial (n=100)" same style
  - Number badge: circle with "1" at top-left corner, warm olive (#8B7D6B) fill, white text 9pt bold

Stage 2 — "Counterfactual Generation" (second, ~20% width):
  - Rounded rectangle, background soft sky blue (#E8F0FE), border (#B8CCE4) 1pt
  - Title: "Counterfactual Generation" in bold serif 11pt
  - Subtitle: "Qwen3-32B" in regular 8.5pt
  - Detail: "style rewriter" in italic 7.5pt, lighter gray (#7F8C8D)
  - Detail: "formal ↔ casual pairs" in italic 7.5pt
  - Number badge: "2", academic blue (#4A6FA5) fill

Stage 3 — "NLI Content Verification" (center, ~20% width):
  - Rounded rectangle, background soft mint (#E8F5E9), border (#A5D6A7) 1pt
  - Title: "NLI Content Verification" in bold serif 11pt
  - Subtitle: "DeBERTa-v3-large" in regular 8.5pt
  - Detail: "threshold ≥ 0.90," in italic 7.5pt
  - Detail: "direction-aware" in italic 7.5pt
  - Number badge: "3", sage green (#5B8C5A) fill

Stage 4 — "Dual Pairwise Scoring" (fourth, ~20% width):
  - Rounded rectangle, background soft lavender (#F3E5F5), border (#CE93D8) 1pt
  - Title: "Dual Pairwise Scoring" in bold serif 11pt
  - Subtitle: "LLM Judge" in regular 8.5pt
  - Detail: "(position A/B swap)" in italic 7.5pt
  - Detail: "2 trials per pair" in italic 7.5pt
  - Number badge: "4", muted purple (#7E57C2) fill

Stage 5 — "Statistical Analysis" (rightmost, ~22% width):
  - Rounded rectangle, background deep navy (#2C3E50), ALL TEXT WHITE
  - Title: "Statistical Analysis" in bold serif 11pt, white
  - Subtitle: "BT model + GEE" in regular 8.5pt, white (#ECF0F1)
  - Detail: "decomposition" in regular 8.5pt, white
  - Detail: "+ Likert comparison" in italic 7.5pt, light gray (#BDC3C7)
  - Number badge: "5", white fill, navy (#2C3E50) text
  - This box visually anchors the pipeline as the "conclusion" stage

ARROWS between stages:
  - Thin, elegant arrows (linewidth 1.2pt), warm gray (#95A5A6)
  - Small triangular arrowheads (not bulky matplotlib defaults)
  - Between each pair of adjacent stages

FLOW ANNOTATIONS (below the arrows, between boxes):
  - Between Stage 1→2: "n=100 pairs" in italic 7.5pt, muted (#95A5A6)
  - Between Stage 2→3: "200 counterfactuals" same style
  - Between Stage 3→4: "88 NLI-pass pairs" same style
  - Between Stage 4→5: "173 valid comparisons" same style
  These annotations show sample attrition through the pipeline.

OVERALL STYLE REQUIREMENTS:
- Publication quality for a TOP venue (NeurIPS/ICML/EMNLP)
- Elegant, premium, sophisticated — NOT cheap or homework-like
- Subtle drop shadows on all boxes: 2px offset, 8% opacity, soft gray
- Rounded corners (10px) on all rectangles
- Thin, elegant arrow heads — not bulky matplotlib defaults
- Serif font (Times New Roman or DejaVu Serif) for all titles
- Sans-serif (Helvetica or DejaVu Sans) for subtitles and annotations
- Muted, harmonious color palette — NO saturated primary colors
- Generous white space between elements (boxes should NOT touch or overlap)
- Consistent visual weight across all stages (same box height)
- All boxes vertically centered on the same baseline
- 300 DPI, white background (#FFFFFF)
- NO matplotlib default styling: no gray background, no thick gridlines, no tab10 colors
- NO axes, no spines, no ticks — this is a clean infographic
- The overall feel should be: a figure you'd see in a Nature Methods or NeurIPS best paper
